arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal fastest finish. 1) Let the start settle; target shaft power near sustainable_shaft_power (~185 W pod) and even effort; reserve to be spent in the last ~800 m (finish cue ~600-700 m to go). 2) Min 3-12: check CP with heart rate (at steady effort near CP, HR should level; still climbing = CP too high). Use measure() on steady legs. 3) Set watches for: pod reserve low, speed loss vs pod power (weed: clear_rudder; pod drift: compare with HR and boat power), HR runaway. 4) Radio messages may change course length: set_race_distance + tell. 5) Save cues (20 max).

Started test piece +8 % for 240 s at race_s ~400 to see if HR levels (CP >= ~198) or keeps climbing (CP below ~198). Turn at ~race_s 625 inside the piece. Baseline before piece: pod 183-188 W, HR 161, rate 62.5.

Then at ~580-605 pod jumped to 212 W with NO speed or HR change: boat_share 0.70 -> 0.59. Suspect POD DRIFT (reading high) starting ~580 (maybe ~440). If confirmed, use boat power (CP 124) + HR for pacing, set pod_gain. Check after the turn at ~race_s 625 and piece end 663.

arguments.text: race_s 625: radio: wind filling in from the SOUTH 8-12 kn. Out legs (odd, heading north ~0 deg) get a tailwind, back legs (even, heading south) a headwind. Before this, current was against on out legs (-0.05) and with us on back legs. Boat computer push_along lags a change: expect speed_water / boat power / boat reserve to be off for a leg or two. Tactic: a little more effort into the headwind legs, a little less with the tailwind (same average).
